name: Ricardo Quispe Chavez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the vibrant colors and meticulous details of racing liveries. He honed his skills through years of working in automotive body shops, eventually specializing in custom paint jobs. His precision and steady hand caught the attention of a local racing team, leading to his first role in motorsport. 

Ricardo approaches his work with a pragmatic mindset, prioritizing durability and efficiency alongside aesthetic appeal. He understands the intense pressures of a race weekend and the need for quick turnaround times. His experience allows him to troubleshoot paint application issues effectively, ensuring the cars look their best on the track. His creative flair, combined with his practical approach, makes him a valuable asset to AF Corse, where he constantly seeks to improve their paint processes and longevity.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height and build, with calloused hands that speak to years of dedicated work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needle point before starting a new project.
Has a collection of vintage automotive paint chips organized by color code.
Hums quietly while working, often Peruvian folk tunes.
